# commander_classic_saas_configuration (Resource)

Creates and manages a **SaaS Configuration** record in the vault. 

The plugin to use must be set as the value of a custom field labeled `SaaS Type`. Because the list of available plugins is fetched from the gateway itself, `gateway` and `configuration` must both be set for Commander to look up and validate plugins for that gateway; see the [SaaS Plugins](https://docs.keeper.io/keeperpam/privileged-access-manager/password-rotation/rotation-use-cases/saas-plugins#keeperpam-saas-rotation-plugins) documentation for the full list of supported plugins. 

After importing an existing SaaS configuration record, `gateway` and `configuration` are not populated; set them manually so Commander can validate the `SaaS Type` against that gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commander_classic_saas_configuration" "example" {
  title = "SaaS Rotation Config"

  notes           = "Configuration for SaaS account rotation."
  folder_location = "_REPLACE_WITH_FOLDER_PATH_OR_UID_"

  configuration = "_REPLACE_WITH_CONFIGURATION_UID_"
  gateway       = "_REPLACE_WITH_GATEWAY_UID_"

  custom = [
    {
      type  = "text"
      label = "SaaS Type"
      value = "REST" // Valid values changes based upon provied gateway and configuration.
    },
    {
      type  = "text"
      label = "Active"
      value = "TRUE" // Valid values are "TRUE" or "FALSE"
    },
  ]

  share = {
    "alice@example.com" = {
      can_share = true
      can_edit  = true
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String) The PAM configuration `UID`. Used at create time to validate the selected **SaaS Type** (plugin) and its fields against the given gateway and configuration. Not populated on import.
- `custom` (Attributes List) Manage custom fields for the record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `gateway` (String) The configured gateway `UID` or `name`. Used at create time to validate the selected **SaaS Type** (plugin) and its fields against the given gateway and configuration. Not populated on import.
- `title` (String) Record title.

### Optional

- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `notes` (String) Manage note for the record.
- `share` (Attributes Map) Mapping of share permissions for this record. Each map **key** is a **user email**; each **value** is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit` booleans. The owner is implicit and never present in this map; the API rejects owner entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Required:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `type` (String) Keeper field type (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`, `phone`, `name`, `date`).
- `value` (String) Field value; for complex types use `jsonencode(JSON)` matching the [Keeper field schema](https://docs.keeper.io/en/keeperpam/secrets-manager/about/field-record-types).

Optional:

- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether to mark the value as sensitive in Terraform state display.


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Optional:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit this record. Defaults to `false`.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share this record with other users. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import commander_classic_saas_configuration.example <RECORD_UID>
```
